displayDescription: A pixel sprite walks a moonlit 3D street, passes behind a pillar, stops under a warm lamp and its idea lights a connected wall network.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.187.0 (WebGLRenderer, bundled locally to three.bundle.js with esbuild)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Illustrative procedural scene: the sprite is an original 12x18 pixel atlas on a nearest-filtered plane; sprite shading under the beam shadow and lamp is an analytic tint keyed to the actor's world position, not true shadow-map lighting on the sprite.
Moonlight shadow of the overhead beam uses a Three.js PCF shadow map; the lamp cone and floor pool are additive approximations of volumetric light.
No tech.preview_recipes are listed in STYLE.json and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so the preview demonstrates the catalogue's characteristic action rather than a reviewed recipe.
Blender was not used per user instruction; all visuals are Three.js/WebGL.
